tasks.short: Track enrolment and document subject dropouts

steps.what: Review actual subject enrollment status, visit events and existing contact records
inputs: existing actual subject enrolment and visit events
staff-entered actual contact attempts
outputs: checked status list with missing or conflicting information flagged

steps.what: Check documented dropout information and distinguish confirmed causes from unknown or disputed causes
inputs: checked status list with missing or conflicting information flagged
actual source records for withdrawal and contact efforts
outputs: verified documented facts and unresolved questions

steps.what: Resolve missing dropout or contact information with the responsible study staff
inputs: verified documented facts and unresolved questions
staff's actual knowledge of subject contact and withdrawal
outputs: actual clarification or explicitly unresolved information

steps.what: Capture actual status, dropout causes and subject contact efforts in the study tracking form
inputs: verified documented facts and unresolved questions
actual clarification or explicitly unresolved information
existing subject identifier
outputs: complete subject status and dropout record draft

steps.what: Approve the completed tracking record against actual sources and preserve unknown causes as unknown
inputs: complete subject status and dropout record draft
actual source records for withdrawal and contact efforts
outputs: approved final subject tracking record

steps.what: Save the approved subject tracking record in the study system
inputs: approved final subject tracking record
outputs: saved subject tracking record

tasks.design: Configure enrolment and missing-information views in the clinical study management system {OPS_SYSTEM}, with a structured dropout/contact form. The coordinator checks sources and captures actual clarification; existing identifiers and validation reduce form setup without inferring a dropout cause.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated status inspection and form setup can surround the work of establishing what actually happened.
tasks.enabler_now: Native study views and structured forms can show existing events and reuse verified identifiers.
tasks.still_hard: Subjects may be unreachable, causes may be unknown, and documented statements may conflict.
tasks.human_edge: The coordinator distinguishes a confirmed withdrawal from missed contact or an unsupported explanation.

ambition.what: Review unresolved enrolment records more frequently without classifying subjects automatically.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2–5 for study-data access and site consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: clinical study systems can show enrolment events and support structured dropout and contact records with validation.

assumptions: Provisional scenario arithmetic, not measured study-management baselines.
Staff already capture actual enrolment, visit and contact events as part of their work; if absent, that capture must be counted before applying this scenario.
The coordinator's new clarification capture is counted in s4; only repeated identifier selection and format correction are reduced.
No subject outreach is silently automated. Any actual contact attempt must be recorded by its performer; this task reviews existing efforts and resolves records with staff.
Use native configuration first. The same-system save receives no saving.
research_questions: How much status inspection remains after native views, and which causes remain genuinely unknown?

already_counted.description: Check complete tracking record against actual sources

incremental.description: Maintain status views and approved dropout/contact field rules

approvals.approved_version: approved final subject tracking record; edits return to s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross is 15 status-view hours +5 form-setup hours =20. Two upkeep hours give central net 18%; four additional hours resolving conflicting source events give high 14%. Low zero if the native study workflow already provides these functions.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Code, evaluate or interpret study data

steps.what: Check collected study data against source identifiers, units, completeness and approved field definitions
inputs: existing collected actual study data with source references
approved data definitions and validation rules
outputs: checked analysis dataset with explicit queries and missingness

steps.what: Apply approved deterministic codes and calculations to structured study values and inspect exceptions
inputs: checked analysis dataset with explicit queries and missingness
versioned approved codebook and calculation rules
outputs: proposed coded dataset and reproducible summaries with unmapped values flagged

steps.what: Resolve ambiguous coding and evaluate or interpret study results without inventing missing responses
inputs: proposed coded dataset and reproducible summaries with unmapped values flagged
actual study source records and analysis plan
outputs: human-resolved coding decisions and interpretation with limitations

steps.what: Prepare the coded-data evaluation record from actual decisions and checked summaries
inputs: human-resolved coding decisions and interpretation with limitations
proposed coded dataset and reproducible summaries with unmapped values flagged
outputs: complete coded-data evaluation record

steps.what: Approve the completed coded dataset and evaluation record against sources, codebook and analysis plan
inputs: complete coded-data evaluation record
versioned approved codebook and calculation rules
human-resolved coding decisions and interpretation with limitations
outputs: approved final coded dataset and evaluation record

steps.what: Commit the approved coded dataset and evaluation record as a versioned analysis package
inputs: approved final coded dataset and evaluation record
outputs: saved versioned analysis package

tasks.design: Configure source-linked validation in {DATA_PLATFORM} and reusable approved coding/calculation rules before adding any custom deterministic mapping. Generate the evaluation record in {DOCS} from checked outputs and human-written interpretation; ambiguous coding remains with the coordinator.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated validation, fixed-value coding and report assembly can add work around substantive evaluation.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned codebooks and reusable analysis rules can repeat known mappings and calculations with explicit exceptions.
tasks.still_hard: Ambiguous source meaning, missing data and interpretation of clinical evidence require qualified people.
tasks.human_edge: The coordinator recognises when a technically valid code would misrepresent the source evidence.

ambition.what: Repeat the approved evaluation when another verified study-data cut is available.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2–5 for study access and investigator/data-manager consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: study data systems can apply versioned validation and deterministic coding rules, flag exceptions and produce reproducible summaries.

assumptions: Shares and savings are provisional scenarios, not measured coding baselines.

Data capture is already performed in the actual study workflow; this task starts from collected data as stated, with source references. Missing records trigger queries rather than free reconstruction.
Only explicit structured mappings are automated. Free-text interpretation, clinical judgement and ambiguous coding remain in s3.
Native validation and coding features are checked first. Same-workspace package commit receives no saving.
The package is committed once as one versioned artefact; separate patient source records are not silently rewritten.
unknowns: Proportion of coding covered by approved explicit rules
research_questions: Which values require human interpretation rather than a fixed approved mapping?

already_counted.description: Check the completed dataset and evaluation package

incremental.description: Maintain versioned mappings, validation rules and regression samples

approvals.approved_version: approved final coded dataset and evaluation record package; changes return to s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross is 10 validation hours +17.5 fixed-coding hours +5.6 record-assembly hours =33.1. Upkeep 3.1 gives central net 30%; six extra hours resolving ambiguous data gives high 24%. Low zero if current tools already provide this or few values support deterministic mapping.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

inputs: verified actual handling status and exceptions

tasks.design: Configure current specimen instructions from {DOCS} and verified requisition fields in the study/specimen system {OPS_SYSTEM}. The coordinator directs people, resolves exceptions and records actual oversight; native templates prepare written directions, which receive final approval before their separate transmission.
tasks.previous_blocker: Looking up protocol details and preparing repeated requisition fields can add work to active specimen oversight.
tasks.enabler_now: Native protocol links and specimen templates can reuse verified identifiers and current approved instructions.
tasks.still_hard: Identity discrepancies, handling exceptions and deciding whether work must stop require trained people.
tasks.human_edge: The coordinator recognises when nominal tracking status does not establish acceptable handling.

ambition.what: Keep specimen directions traceable without automating physical handling or exception decisions.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2–5 for protocol review and specimen-system permissions

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: study and specimen systems can link approved protocols and populate requisition templates from verified specimen fields.

assumptions: All shares and savings are provisional, not measured handling baselines.
The focal task directs work. Trained staff perform and record actual collection, labeling, storage and shipment; none of their physical labour is claimed as saving.
Specimen identifiers and actual status originate in staff records; missing records must be obtained and counted rather than inferred from a plan.

s4b approves the completed instructions and s4c sends them before staff execution. s5 checks actual staff-produced records after execution; s6 captures oversight and s7 separately approves that completed record.
Use native fields and templates first. Internal transmission and same-system save receive no saving.
unknowns: Completeness of specimen identifiers and actual event records
research_questions: Which requisition fields can safely reuse verified data without presuming collection or shipment?

already_counted.description: Check final requisition message and actual oversight record

incremental.description: Maintain protocol links and requisition template mappings

approvals.approved_version: approved exact requisition/instruction message and recipients; changes return to s4b
approved final actual specimen oversight record from s7

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross is 6 protocol-lookup hours +10 requisition-preparation hours =16. Two upkeep hours give central net 14%; four extra hours resolving identifier discrepancies give high 10%. Low zero with current native coverage. Physical handling has no claimed saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

actual staff training needs and prior completion records

approved instructional text and examples
outputs: complete study instruction materials

current approved study procedures and standards

tasks.design: Configure current approved procedure links in {DOCS} and reusable instructional materials in {LMS}. The coordinator checks the complete materials before teaching, assesses actual understanding, then records and approves actual completion after delivery.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding current procedures and repeatedly arranging approved instructional text can take time before instruction.
tasks.enabler_now: Native controlled-document links and reusable learning layouts can assemble approved material without generating new clinical instructions.
tasks.still_hard: Staff questions, misunderstandings and deciding whether someone needs more instruction remain human.
tasks.human_edge: The coordinator can test understanding against the real study rather than assume competence from attendance.

ambition.what: Prepare approved study instruction for another staff group without relaxing assessment.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2–5 for protocol-owner review and staff-learning access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: controlled document and learning systems can reuse approved instructional material and record actual completion and assessment separately.

assumptions: Shares and savings are provisional scenarios, not measured instruction baselines.
Approved scientific, consent and documentation content already exists; no model invents clinical instruction.
The coordinator selects content and checks meaning during preparation and approval. Teaching and assessment remain fully retained.
s6 captures actual outcomes only after s4 and s5; no pre-training enrolment or notice is treated as completed instruction.
Native features first. No saving is assigned to actual outcome capture or the same-system save.
research_questions: Which approved material assembly remains repetitive after native configuration?

already_counted.description: Check completed instructional materials against approved procedures

incremental.description: Maintain procedure links and approved reusable learning layouts

approvals.approved_version: approved final instructional materials; changes require renewed s3
approved final actual training record; edits return to s7

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross is 8 source-preparation hours +8 material-assembly hours =16. Two upkeep hours give central net 14%; four extra hours resolving protocol-version changes give high 10%. Low zero if existing native materials already cover this preparation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: investigator and data manager: approve definitions and scientific interpretation
specimen staff: perform and record actual handling
study staff: demonstrate actual procedural understanding
role.ambitious_version: A clinical research coordinator who can inspect current evidence and prepare records faster while keeping subject facts, scientific interpretation and staff competence under accountable human review.
